id: title:jose-sequeira:index feature flag property definitions by project

review.posthog_relevance: Changes query execution and retrieval performance for property definitions, including a database index optimization for feature flag lookups.
review.reason: The chunk replaces a FULL OUTER JOIN with a LEFT JOIN, removing an explicit join to an enterprise-only table when not available. This could alter query behavior and compatibility with downstream filtering or aggregation. Additionally, a database index is added with a partial condition for names starting with '$feature/', which could improve query performance for feature flag look.
review.uncertainty: While the code changes are substantive and bounded, the actual compatibility and performance gains depend on downstream query assumptions and database behavior, which are not demonstrated. No tests or release notes are provided to verify the benefit. No adoption or incident avoidance is inferred.

observations.limitations: This chunk represents a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No tier assignment performed.
